## Existing Wednesday GEO/SEO work → actual public acceptance check (2026-10-21)

Follow through on the previously merged real publisher-schema fix [Koios site PR #2](https://github.com/causeway-services/koios-news-site/pull/2) and the observed branded Koios query collision in [Publication Discovery PR #3](https://github.com/causeway-services/publication-discovery-services-section/pull/3). This patch changes **the original read-only Koios publisher-discovery auditor**, not another SEO scanner and not a public article.

### Defect observed from the original receiver

The existing `publisher-identity` finding calls homepage identity "pass" merely because any Organization JSON-LD appears. It never checks that homepage WebSite.publisher is the same canonical entity as the article's NewsArticle.publisher. The recently merged actual site source now has stable IDs `/#publisher` and `/#website`, but original green site-source CI does **not** establish that those IDs have appeared on production HTTP pages.

### Repair in the original consumer

- Inspect actual fetched homepage HTML for canonical same-origin `NewsMediaOrganization` / `WebSite` `@id` values and a true WebSite.publisher → Organization relation, without inventing a declared relationship.
- Inspect the sampled served article's actual `publisher.@id` and original publisher name and URL. Emit two distinct noncritical `publisher-graph-linkage` and `article-publisher-linkage` findings: **pass** on verified correspondence, **fail** on observed missing/conflicting references, **unknown** when the public endpoints were not observed.
- Preserve the former broader `publisher-identity`, indexing/robots checks, original cadence check, and all no-claim rules. Missing linked data is **not asserted to be a Google deindexing cause or proof of changed ranking**.
- Extend positive/negative/error/legacy-fixture native tests for true links, offsite masquerade, disconnected IDs and observable-but-old hosted markup.
- Extend the original `.github/workflows/discovery-readiness.yml` to run when authoring source changes and report real live graph results in GitHub Actions, not equate green merged source with deployed success.

### Receiving

Require native dependency-free contract CI on this exact PR head, merge only on independently passing test receipt, then observe same-origin live Koios from the main-branch workflow. The older live independent [discovery run 39625218688](https://github.com/causeway-services/koios-news-site/actions/runs/39625218688) showed HTTP 200 fundamentals and **0 advertised new article URLs/24 hours vs target 20**; article had zero external citations. Neither finding is hidden by this patch. A genuine site release remains a separately owed operation, not authorized or claimed by this PR.

No customer/identity information, actual provider tokens, paid action, editorial acceptance or AI-only optimization is introduced.
title: GEO: independently verify live Koios homepage-to-article publisher identity
